content: Nadi-9 typically follows a Subject-Object-Verb (SOV) word order.
author: linguist_primary

content: The past tense is marked by the suffix '-va' on verbs.
author: linguist_primary

content: The future tense is indicated by the suffix '-ki' on verbs.
author: linguist_primary

content: Negation is expressed using the prefix 'na-' attached to verbs.
author: linguist_primary

content: Respect towards elders is shown by appending the suffix '-jin' to kinship terms or names.
author: linguist_primary

content: When addressing a younger sibling or person, the suffix '-su' is used.
author: linguist_primary

content: Politeness levels often dictate vocabulary choice depending on the speaker's status relative to the listener.
author: linguist_primary

content: Code-switching with English is common in informal contexts.
author: linguist_primary
